def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    t=Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch)
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(t)}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M']
    # proper 2x2 clustering: find top-left corners
    s=set(cells); tl=sorted((r,c) for r,c in s if (r,c) in s and (r+1,c) in s and (r,c+1) in s and (r+1,c+1) in s)
    return tl
def bcells(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); return [(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='b']
print("before M:",mblocks(current_frame)," ball center:",(sum(r for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//len(bcells(current_frame)), sum(c for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//len(bcells(current_frame))))
b=current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':27,'col':33}])
print("click(27,33):",summ(diff(b,current_frame))," M:",mblocks(current_frame))
print("done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    t=Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch)
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(t)}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M']
    # proper 2x2 clustering: find top-left corners
    s=set(cells); tl=sorted((r,c) for r,c in s if (r,c) in s and (r+1,c) in s and (r,c+1) in s and (r+1,c+1) in s)
    return tl
def bcells(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); return [(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='b']
print("before M:",mblocks(current_frame)," ball center:",(sum(r for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//len(bcells(current_frame)), sum(c for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//len(bcells(current_frame))))
b=current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':27,'col':33}])
print("click(27,33):",summ(diff(b,current_frame))," M:",mblocks(current_frame))
print("done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
print("ball center now:",(sum(r for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//max(1,len(bcells(current_frame))), sum(c for r,c in bcells(current_frame))//max(1,len(bcells(current_frame)))))
</parameter>
</function>
